differentiators.observation: Native ephemeral typing/presence with typed declarations, TTL, rate budgets, and verified zero durable write amplification (20 publishes, durable version pinned). The frozen Convex chat arm needed durable TTL rows plus heartbeat/cleanup glue and still recorded typing and presence as explicit GAPs.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The ephemeral lane never touches durable versions, and the declaration carries TTL/rate/value budgets the server enforces.

differentiators.observation: Revocation-active protected live handles: an established subscription blanks ~1.7s after the authority change, later commits are not delivered, and every denial is the uniform non-disclosing SNAPBACK_AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED {kind:'role'} — read and subscribe alike. This matches the strongest frozen competitor result (Convex) while adding the non-disclosure property.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Blank-then-terminal-deny ordering on established handles and byte-uniform denials that reveal neither resource nor membership existence.

differentiators.observation: Cross-client push delivery of a committed row in 33-37ms over the managed stream with meta-kind attribution, comparable to the frozen Convex 40ms median, with the whole 12-check suite (three sessions, revocation, reconnect, TTL waits included) finishing in ~9s.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Durable live delivery produced from the committed write set (never partial mutations) over the multiplexed managed socket.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: evidence/report.json (per-check ms) vs diaries/0028 Convex performance table

differentiators.observation: Settlement-grade idempotency evidence for free: the structured mutation envelope (result + changed_count + version + receipt) plus a unique dedupe index made 'retry returns the original id with changed_count 0' a one-line machine assertion. No frozen competitor arm surfaced retry effect-neutrality in its envelope.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The closed mutation result envelope and one-commit-one-version semantics.

differentiators.observation: Dev-loop lifecycle as protocol: ready descriptor + snapback.dev.v1 events + stdin-close stop made every suite/smoke own its server without log parsing; sessions minting for tests is ~100ms per persona once known — far lighter than the Convex custom-JWT ceremony the frozen arm fought.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The machine-readable ready/lifecycle contract and the three-authority gate on dev session minting.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: evidence/app/acceptance.a2.mjs lifecycle preamble; finding f6 (the recipe must become documentation to count)

differentiators.observation: Server-authoritative deterministic message order came free from _version (commit order): no app sequence counter, no OCC hot row under concurrent sends, and the cursor stayed stable across appends.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Monotonic per-commit versions shared by all rows of a commit, exposed on documents results.
